visualCharacteristics.purpose: Strip of icon + title + short text service boxes on light grey (#ececec), 3 across on desktop
visualCharacteristics.description: Three light-grey (#ececec) boxes in a row, each with an icon on the left and a title plus short description on the right; stacks on mobile.

contentPattern.structure: one row per box; cell 1 = icon image, cell 2 = bold title or heading followed by a description paragraph; a single link in cell 2 makes the whole box clickable

cells: Title (bold or heading) + description; a single link makes the whole box clickable

usage: Service / policy strip (Free Shipping, Customer Service, Register).
reuseGuidance: Use for short icon + title + text feature or benefit items. For image-on-top content cards use cards.
